title: Vehicles and mopeds without required equipment or in unsafe condition.
partHeading: PART II. INSPECTION OF VEHICLES AND MOPEDS
bodyText: No person shall drive or cause to move on any highway any motor vehicle, moped, trailer, semitrailer, or pole trailer, or any combination thereof, unless the equipment thereon is in good working order and adjustment as required in this part and does not endanger the driver or other occupant or any person upon the highway.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: Part heading amended by L 2017, c 12, §61.

bodyHtml:
PART II.  INSPECTION OF VEHICLES AND MOPEDS

 

Note

 

  Part heading amended by L 2017, c 12, §61.

 

     §286-21  Vehicles and mopeds without required equipment or in unsafe condition.  No person shall drive or cause to move on any highway any motor vehicle, moped, trailer, semitrailer, or pole trailer, or any combination thereof, unless the equipment thereon is in good working order and adjustment as required in this part and does not endanger the driver or other occupant or any person upon the highway. [L 1967, c 214, pt of §2; HRS §286-21; am L 2016, c 200, §7]
